After that, I need to rent a car in Paris for 7 days. I prefer a SUV and I will pick it up from the airport. Then, I need to book another hotel room in Rome for 3 nights. I prefer a suite and would like to add airport transfer service. Lastly, I need to rent a car in Rome for 5 days. I prefer a compact car and I will pick it up from the hotel."
